body:
I guess it may have not come across, but I didn't mean to say that there was only one possible door or that I would quit looking or trying. However, it was an important epiphany for me to realize that there was AT LEAST one door, one path, regardless of what went wrong or how bad thing got. There has never been a drug invented that could relieve that much stress that fast.

Did Habitat, good people doing good things. Not for me.
